correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts all basic l-vectors at \(n=6\). Nonnegative directions are dimension-free in the source; negative directions with a zero reduce to the source \(n\le5\) cases; the only full-support patterns have \(p=3,4,5\) positives. The \(R(1)\) case split follows from Lemma A.1, and the nonpositive-block case is exactly Lemma A.2 with (p-1,p-1)=(2,2),(3,3),(4,4). Linearity and the source reduction then yield likelihood-ratio order. The standalone verifier returned VERIFY_OK on algebraic identities and stress tests; finite checks are not used as the infinite proof.
